participant_id.Description: Pseudo-subject. sub-pooled is NOT one person: it pools anonymous 20-s signal pairs drawn at random from the long-term intracranial EEG of five patients. The source did not store which patient a pair came from, so per-patient subjects cannot be formed.

n_patients_pooled.Description: Number of patients whose recordings contributed segments (Andrzejak et al. 2012, Sec. II A).

age.Description: Not reported per patient by the source.

sex.Description: Not reported per patient by the source.
